ddalchum.name: Ddalchum
ddalchum.effect: The user busts out a wild dance, raising every one of its stats by 2 stages. It must recharge on the next turn.

causalityCollapse.name: Causality Collapse
causalityCollapse.effect: A psychic strike that lands before the target can even react. May cause flinching. Can't be used twice in a row.
